# Code of conduct

OnlyRead follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful and constructive, assume good faith, and keep discussion about the work. Harassment,
personal attacks, and publishing someone's private information are not accepted in issues, pull requests or
any other project space.

Two rules specific to this project, because it handles real accounts:

- Never post recordings, request bodies, tokens or screenshots that show another person's data. Redact them,
  as `npm run scrub` checks for your own.
- Report a bypass privately (see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)), not in a public issue.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behavior to the maintainers at **support@onlyread.ai**. Reports are handled privately, and the
maintainers will act as the Covenant's enforcement guidelines describe.
